source: Mord Hive v0.5 uses the shared Mordheim advance mechanic (the Experience section, pp.100-101, shows the same New Skill / Characteristic Increase results). Table reused from the core rules; a Hero who can cast may generate a power instead of a skill. Henchmen never add more than +1 to any single characteristic and may not exceed racial maximums; re-roll an already-maxed result. All warriors in a Henchman group gain the same advance.

The lad's got talent. One model in the group becomes a Hero (re-roll if already at the max number of Heroes). The new Hero keeps his Henchman type, starting XP, and characteristic increases; choose two Hero skill lists available in your warband for him to use. He immediately makes one roll on the Heroes Advance table. Remaining group members (if any) roll again for their own advance, re-rolling any 10-12 results.
